chunks: Any camel on which hajj is performed for three years will be made among the livestock of Paradise.
And it has been narrated: “Seven years.”

key_terms.بَعِيرٍ: a camel used as a riding animal

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a camel used for hajj over multiple years?
ai.summary: This hadith states the virtue granted to a camel used repeatedly for hajj, declaring that such an animal will be made among the livestock of Paradise. It highlights the spiritual merit connected to the means employed in acts of worship and preserves a variant report stating seven years instead of three.
